exploratory_finalist_selection: Among completed uniform4000_h5 and recovery2000_h5 choose greatest placements across the same20 new development starts; tie prefers uniform4000_h5. Include that single model as exploratory, even if it does not beat the original. Do not run final tests for the other exploratory model.
primary_selection: Maximum development placements over completed candidates, original first in ties; existing matched2k tie order then uniform4000_h5 then recovery2000_h5. If original wins, retain it as selected_candidate and label every adaptation secondary.
promotion: Only the development-selected non-reference candidate may be promoted. Its final total placements must exceed original and its narrow count must not fall. Secondary final outcomes may not select a replacement winner. If reference is selected or criterion fails, retain original.
fallback_if_time_insufficient: Before lock only, reduce to complete reference plus selected model evaluations and label matched2k ablation development-only; never drop a group or model after seeing its final outcomes.
uncertainty: Per-group Wilson intervals and fixed-checkpoint paired discordances. Additional contrasts exploratory, unadjusted p values descriptive, one training seed.
